Class DatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.DatabaseManager
public class DatabaseManager extends Object
SQLite and chat-file access for the marketplace. Listing chat is stored in chat_history.json, keyed by listing id and then by buyer username.

    • clearDatabase

      public static void clearDatabase()
      Deletes marketplace rows from data.db and replaces chat_history.json with an empty JSON object.

      Every application table is emptied and autoincrement counters are reset. Active admin accounts are written back, and existing demo_data_seed markers are restored so the next launch does not recreate the sample listings. Deactivated or deleted admin accounts are not restored.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the database or chat file cannot be updated

    • createBorrowRequest

      public static int createBorrowRequest(String buyerUsername, int listingId, LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end)
      Creates or updates a borrow request. The requested length must be at least MIN_BORROW_SECONDS and at most the listing's lending period. proposed_days stores the requested length rounded up to whole days.
      Parameters:
      buyerUsername - buyer making the request
      listingId - lend listing
      start - borrow start
      end - borrow end
      Returns:
      the request id
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the dates or the lending period are not usable
      IllegalStateException - if the request cannot be saved
